fact: Gyrgum offers an optional NDA, which Werz interprets as a "Non-Demonic Agreement," to keep their dealings secret.
source_quote: Gyrgum offered an optional NDA — which Werz heard as a "Non-Demonic Agreement"
subject: NDA offer

fact: Gyrgum stares knowingly at the ghost, causing the ghost to say "boo."
source_quote: Gyrgum stared knowingly at the ghost, and the ghost said "boo."
subject: ghost intimidation

fact: Werz Saltbaron agrees to sign the contract because it will be enforced by the ghost.
source_quote: I will gladly sign such a contract, especially if it will be enforced by a fearsome ghost like this.
subject: Werz Saltbaron

fact: Gyrgum drafts a formal contract with his fancy pen while Daz helps set the price.
source_quote: Gyrgum drafts a formal contract with his fancy pen while Daz helps set the price.
subject: contract drafting

fact: Daz sets a list price of 1,250 gold pieces for the NDA.
source_quote: Daz set a "list price" of 1,250 gold pieces
subject: price setting

fact: Daz offers the NDA for a flat thousand gold pieces.
source_quote: generously offered it at a flat thousand
subject: initial discount offer

fact: The price of the NDA is raised to eleven hundred gold pieces after Werz calls it highway robbery.
source_quote: the price was immediately raised to eleven hundred
subject: price increase

fact: Werz pays the 1,100 gold piece fee and the NDA is concluded.
source_quote: Werz paid without further argument, having learned his lesson.
subject: NDA payment

fact: Werz provides information about various Duergar clans, including Clan Ironhead, Clan Thrazgad, and Clan Xundom.

subject: Werz reveals Duergar clans

fact: Clan Thrazgad is a clan of armorsmiths who complain their stores have been raided recently.
source_quote: Clan Thrazgad is another clan of armorsmiths who complain their stores have been raided recently.
subject: Clan Thrazgad

fact: Clan Xundom will back the Deepking if there's any contest for power.
source_quote: Clan Xundom will back the Deepking if there's any contest for power.
subject: Clan Xundom

fact: The party presses Werz on the fact that only the NDA's price was negotiated, never the job itself.

subject: job clarification

fact: Werz states the deal is that the party removes the assassins in exchange for his services to Blingdenstone.

subject: job terms stated

fact: Werz gives the party five special gems as a symbol of good faith.
source_quote: Werz gives the party five special gems as a symbol of good faith
subject: gems offered

fact: The five special gems are valued at 100 GP each.
source_quote: Daz asks their value, and it is put at 100 GP each.
subject: special gems

fact: The party agrees to deal with the assassins targeting Werz in exchange for his influence and trade favors in Blingdenstone.

fact: Thorin almost blurted out the NDA's price but missed the save.
source_quote: Thorin: "I almost blurted out how much money you got, but I missed the save."
